format: shadowveil idle clips v1 (same as idle_clips.json)
spec: value(t) = linear interpolation of keys[param] (viewKeys[view][param] overrides for that view); t wraps at duration
units: rig param units (-1..1; body deg = value x 25, BodyLean x 8)

timeline.shape: ShoulderL 0.5 swing (1 cycle) + ElbowL 0.3 lag 0.32 s; ShoulderR -0.15 / ElbowR -0.1 counter; BodyLean 0->0.2 @+2 s->0; right leg planted bend hip 5 deg @+2 s (knee/ankle solved per view); left (standing) leg 0

body_showcase.notes: Solo sweeps go to the full current limit (+-1.0). Pelvis is the fixed root: during HipL/HipR/KneeL/KneeR/AnkleL/AnkleR solos only that leg moves (the other, standing leg stays 0 -> no lift); the swinging foot itself leaves the floor by design (about 73 px at hip 25 deg, 39 px at knee 25 deg in apose). Combined: free right foot lifts {'apose': 2.53, 'tpose': 2.58, 'left': 2.49, 'right': 2.04, 'back': 2.41} px at the 5 deg bend peak (standing foot 0). Fingers/wrists at Hands rest (0 = drawn f0), mouth rest, eyes/hair rig auto.
